Privacy notice

This notice explains how information submitted through the property enquiry form on ramrealty.in is used.

What you may share

The form asks for your name and phone number, and may collect your budget range, preferred area, buying timeline, home-loan preference, callback time, and campaign/referrer details. Please do not submit financial account numbers or identity documents through this form.

How the information is used

Ram Realty uses the details to respond to your property enquiry, share relevant listing information, and arrange a callback or site visit if requested. Form submissions are processed by Netlify Forms and made available to the Ram Realty site owner in the Netlify dashboard. Campaign tags may be stored with the enquiry to help identify which promotion brought the visitor to the site.

Sharing and retention

Your enquiry details should be accessed only by people handling your request and service providers needed to operate the website and form. They are not intended for unrelated marketing or public display. Netlify may process submission data under its own service terms and settings. Ram Realty should remove enquiries when they are no longer needed for the enquiry or applicable record-keeping.

Your choices

You can choose not to submit the form and contact Ram Realty directly by phone or WhatsApp. To request access, correction, or deletion of an enquiry, call or WhatsApp +91 77992 51808 and identify the enquiry and phone number used.

This notice describes the current enquiry form. Update it if the site begins using analytics, advertising pixels, a CRM, or other data collection.
